==English==

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*per-|id=before}}
Partially a {{back-formation|en|preparation|nocap=1}}; and partially borrowed from {{bor|en|frm|preparer}}, from Classical {{der|en|la|praeparo|praeparāre|t=make ready in advance}}, from {{m|la|prae-|t=pre-}} + {{m|la|paro|parāre|t=make ready}}. Compare {{cog|enm|preparaten|t=to prepare}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/pɹɪˈpɛə/|/pɹɪˈpɛː/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/pɹɪˈpɛ(ə)ɹ/|/pɹəˈpɛ(ə)ɹ/|a=GenAm}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-prepare.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛə(ɹ)|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To make [[ready]] for a [[specific]] future purpose; to [[set up]]; to [[assemble]] or [[equip]]; to forearm.
#: {{ux|en|We '''prepared''' the spacecraft for takeoff.}}
#* {{RQ:KJV|Psalms|107|36|text=that they may '''prepare''' a city for habitation}}
#* {{RQ:Dryden Fables|The Flower and the Leaf|text=our souls, not yet '''prepared''' for upper light}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To make ready for eating or drinking; to [[cook]].
#: {{ux|en|We '''prepared''' a fish for dinner.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To make [[oneself]] ready; to get ready, make preparation.
#: {{syn|en|get|}}
#: {{ux|en|We '''prepared''' for a bumpy ride.}}
#* {{RQ:Allingham China Governess|chapter=19|passage=As soon as Julia returned with a constable, Timothy, who was on the point of exhaustion, '''prepared''' to give over to him gratefully. The newcomer turned out to be a powerful youngster, fully trained and eager to help, and he stripped off his tunic at once.}}
#* {{quote-web
|en
|date=10 April 2023
|title=Taiwan's frontline islanders resigned in face of Chinese military might
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230410102510/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230410-taiwan-s-frontline-islanders-resigned-in-face-of-chinese-military-might
|work=w:France 24
|text=Tourists visited a memorial hall adorned by a slogan in the handwriting of Chiang Kai-shek, Taiwan's divisive former nationalist leader: "Stay alert and '''prepare''' for battle."}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To produce or make by combining elements; to [[synthesize]], [[compound]].
#: {{ux|en|She '''prepared''' a meal from what was left in the cupboards.}}

====Usage notes====
* This is a [[catenative verb]] that can take a following verb in its ''to + [[infinitive]]'' form. See [[Appendix:English catenative verbs]]

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|stem=prepar|old=1}}

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|busk}} {{qual|obsolete}}, {{l|en|graith}} {{qual|obsolete}}, {{l|en|ready}}, {{l|en|yark}} {{qual|obsolete}}
* {{sense|To make oneself ready}} {{l|en|get ready}}

====Derived terms====
{{col|en|disprepare|misprepare|overprepare|preparability|preparable|preparate|preparement|preprepare|reprepare
|preparingly|foreprepare|if you want peace, prepare for war|failure to prepare is preparing to fail|fore-prepare|hope for the best, prepare for the worst|pre-prepare|prepare the ground|prepare the way|unprepare|prepare ahead|prepare up}}

====Related terms====
* {{l|en|preparation}}
* {{l|en|preparatory}}
